Let the MPAA keep playing wack-a-mole. Most important though, so that whoaverse isn't a mole to be wacked: make sure to have all links be in the form of a google redirect

https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&url=(YOUR_HTTP_LINK_HERE)

The theory is that if the links are legal, then the MPAA won't send those stupid DMCA take-down requests. But anyone who has been paying attention knows that those DMCS take-down requests are automated and are also very inaccurate. Since the links are legal, no Safe Harbor argument should be needed, but rather than actually try to argue safe harbor, we can let Google do the arguing by using the redirect links.
